notes: Clean, surgical delivery: no signature, return, route, HTML or schema change; mysqli kept; characterization 22/22 green. Visibility enforced in the ver route, listing (PHP-side filter preserving listarChamados' signature) and export (session-driven filter inside exportarCsv; sessionless callers still get every ticket) — enforcement, not COMP-003 (rule 6). mediaResposta still averages all tickets (no scoping). SEC-015 has two report findings (F11 for config.php:12, F4 for :15); F11's confidence used. Deliberate non-fixes with stated reasons: SEC-014 (MD5), DB_PASS fallback, SEC-008 (claims the formula-prefix would break the CSV contract — the matrix expects prefixing as the fix), CSRF, LIKE wildcard escaping (the matrix note treats wildcard escaping as part of a complete SEC-001 fix; C3 is probe-driven and the probe passed). BUG-004 was fixed silently while restructuring exportarCsv. The export file no longer persists at EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv; the manifest only contracts the CSV written to output, so this is not COMP. achados.json leb binding (LEB-100-A, 1.1, sha 68088ab...) matches the matrix.

expl_justification.clareza: It has a Resumo with the method (characterize, fix, re-run), compact blocks with a one-line header per finding (severity, confidence, fixed), demonstrated impacts and post-fix checks, a Decisoes table and a compatibility section. It is concise and direct.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are largely correct. The CONCAT UNION puts login:md5 in the rendered title. A tautology payload returns everything. The int-typed concatenations are not exploitable today. tempnam creates the per-request file with mode 0600. The verified CSV header is the quoted '"Aberto em"'. The '%' and quote cases are preserved. One loose claim: F5 calls DivisionByZeroError 'erro fatal, nao excecao capturavel por catch comum', but it is an Error that catch (DivisionByZeroError) or catch (Throwable) handles. The F12 deferral also rests on 'os titulos hoje vem de canal interno', which the package does not show.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The mechanisms are concrete and demonstrated: $papel 'lido na linha 39 e nunca usado' across the three routes, the fixed-name file both raced and left downloadable by guessable URL, the loop that never runs leaving $qtd at 0, and the fixation plus missing HttpOnly chain with F3. There is no cross-finding synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The fixed findings come first in severity order, but the unfixed ones are grouped at the end, so F10 and F11 (alta) follow F9 (baixa) without that ordering principle being stated, the same pattern as R. Effort and risk inform the deferrals, not the ranking.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Several decisions are argued. The asymmetry between the two secrets is the strongest: the SMTP literal goes because nothing here uses it, while the DB_PASS fallback stays because it is 'funcionalmente load-bearing' until rotation. Also argued: Secure is not forced over plain HTTP, wildcards are kept, CSRF is left to SameSite=Lax, and tecnicoNome is kept. The MD5 deferral treats migration as a full rehash and reset ('rehash de todos os usuarios') rather than weighing the gated rehash-on-login it names. The export filter is put inside exportarCsv by reading the session, coupling the public function to web state, without a comparison against a separate function.
